blocks.text: In verses 5–9, Wisdom is spoken of as “her”: she can be loved, embraced, and honored. This belongs to Proverbs 1–9’s disputed interpretive pattern of portraying Wisdom and Folly as women whose calls and paths represent rival desires and outcomes. Here, the imagery makes the father’s instruction more than abstract advice: Wisdom is presented as a relationship to hold onto and pursue.

sections.title: Wisdom as a Figure to Pursue
